author: Lam
split: Provided train.csv (143,771 rows) / test.csv (70,814 rows); seed=42. Ten-fold CV on train using the shared fold assignments. Test used only once after tuning.
notes: 10-fold CV uses the shared fold assignments; scale_pos_weight was searched within each training fold; best value was 1.0 (no positive-class reweighting). standard SHAP summary/bar/dependence PNGs are saved in shap_figures/. 30-trial randomized grid search, seed 42. Mean CV MSE=0.141930; mean CV MAE=0.284387. Test accuracy=0.796594, balanced_accuracy=0.565172, recall_SCA1=0.970533, recall_SCA0=0.159810, ROC-AUC=0.765981. Class metrics use 0.50 cutoff. Assumes SCA=1 is abandonment. The agreed train/test files have 66 exact record overlaps; files provided by the group were used unchanged, so test estimates may be mildly optimistic.Train.csv values were used with fold IDs aligned by row order. Summary and dependence plots use a seeded 30,000-row display sample; saved OOF matrices contain all training rows.
